body:
# TBME — The Better Minecraft Experience

**Version:** 1.21.10+ (Fabric)

TBME isn’t about flooding Minecraft with new dimensions or over-complicated systems. It’s about refining the core game — enhancing visuals, sound, and performance to create a smoother, richer, and more immersive experience while keeping the vanilla spirit intact.

---

## Visual Overhaul
- **Iris, Sodium, Lithium** – High performance with full shader support.
- **Complementary, Bliss, and Lethal Shaders** – Realistic lighting and depth.
- **Fusion series** (Connected Textures, Emissive Ores, 3D Items, and more) – Visual cohesion and detail.
- **Entity Texture Features & ArmorSkin** – Personality for mobs and armor.
- **Distant Horizons** – Seamless world rendering for far-off vistas.

---

## Immersive Audio
- **Sound Physics Perfected** and **Presence Footsteps** – Realistic acoustics.
- **Windy** and **Sounds by IMB11** – Ambient soundscapes that react to your surroundings.

---

## Gameplay & Quality of Life
- **AppleSkin, FireHud, Held Item Tooltips, Potion Bar** – Survival clarity.
- **Notes** and **Cherished Worlds** – Stay organized.
- **ClickThrough Plus, Mouse Tweaks, Item Descriptions** – UI refinement.
- **Simple Voice Chat & Simple Music Control** – Multiplayer enhancements.
- **Fish on the Line** and **Simple Auto Fishing** – Relaxed fishing upgrades.

---

## Performance & Optimization
- **FerriteCore, More Culling, ImmediatelyFast, Raise Sound Limit Simplified** – Max performance.
- **Fabric API, Collective, Forge Config API Port, Puzzles Lib, YACL** – Stability and compatibility.

---

## Aesthetic Polish
- **qrafty’s Capitalized Font** – Modern UI text.
- **Back To Basics** – Rebalanced gameplay for a familiar yet refined feel.

---

<details>
<summary>Why TBME?</summary>

TBME represents what Minecraft could be at its best: clean, beautiful, optimized, and immersive.  
Every mod was chosen to **enhance** the game, not overload it — crafting a world that feels **natural, cohesive, and truly better.**
</details>

---

### Summary
A refined and optimized Minecraft experience that enhances visuals, sound, and performance — all while keeping the vanilla feel intact.
